propositions: rebar has rich event-sourced history but no aggregation layer and no way to trend agent-driven dev loop metrics over time
three Tier-C blindspots leave no durable trace in the event store today: env/integration-diagnosis intervals, bug provenance (caused_by), and bug outcome classification
passive instrumentation must emit agent-lifecycle signals only where they leave no trace, stamped by trustworthy code (gate error handlers, git blame) rather than agent self-report

caused_by edges are auto-derived from git blame of the pre-fix state over file_impact, with explicit --caused-by override always winning, but skipped when blame cannot resolve a single commit or blamed edges would be silently rejected by closed-source guards
bug-close friction must stay flat by replacing the required free-text --reason with a required bounded --class enum persisted on STATUS events, not supplementing it

rebar metrics command surfaces metrics across agent-process, gate-economics, and code-health lenses with date-range queries, where unavailable metrics report structured unavailable state with accruing_since metadata and light up automatically as data arrives
